verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented notification capability that alerts a developer when an agent finishes a task or needs input. The watch receipt with COMPLETED state is run output, Ledger records only store status and blockers, and the Slack/GitHub integration returns completed responses to the thread a task came from. That integration is a separate intake-and-reply feature, not developer notifications, and nothing covers 'needs my input' alerts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get notified when an agent completes a task or needs my input
